rosewood.fitNote: True to size with a narrow toe box. Take your usual size if your feet are narrow or regular. If your feet are wide, consider going up half a size.
rosewood.colourNote: Rosewood is a deep red-brown with a slight purple cast. It is darker than it looks on most screens and is not bright pink.
